question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

Open to more than one interpretation, not having one obvious meaning
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ambiguous**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ambiguous **means having multiple meanings or interpretations. (अनेक अर्थ या व्याख्याएँ होना)
 
• The word is derived from the Latin word "**ambiguus**" which means doubtful or uncertain.
 
• It is commonly used in literature, law, and politics.
 
 
• **For example-** *The politician's statement was so ambiguous that it was difficult to understand his true intentions.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, it is clear that the phrase "**Open to more than one interpretation, not having one obvious meaning**" is similar in meaning to '**Ambiguous**.'

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us look at the meanings of the other words.

 
• **Alchemy **refers to the medieval practice of turning base metals into gold or finding a universal cure for diseases. (रसायन विज्ञान)
 
• **Amateur **means a person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid basis. (शौक़ीन व्यक्ति)
 
• **Altercation **means a noisy argument or disagreement, especially in public. (तकरार)
